goals: Locally authored native exact differential with a 65536-byte clustering threshold.

Pure equal-map redirect barrels preserve default and named canonical identities across x={a,b} and y={b,c} overlapping masks; callable then and destructured root aliases deliberately cover the conservative native fallback, not guarded extraction.
Static imports of callable then, __proto__, and init exports must not collide with private activation helpers or leak then onto root namespaces.
Static destructuring avoids reflection, but typed segment membership is unchanged with clustering disabled; do not count this case as clustering-transform coverage.
